envelope.description: TypeScript calls outside any function are credited to the file

body.title: TypeScript calls outside any function are credited to the file
body.summary: walkNode extracts calls with the file entity as caller from program-level statements that are not declarations it handles, from each non-function declarator value of a program-level or exported lexical/variable declaration, and from an export_statement's value (export default <expr>); exported function and class declarations are walked as today and never scanned with the file as caller.
acceptanceChecks: Calls in a program-level expression statement, including nested describe/test callbacks, are CALLS from the file entity, in .ts and .js sources.
Non-function program-level and exported initializers, and export default, are CALLS from the file entity.
Calls in function declarations, class methods, exported functions and classes and function-valued declarators keep their caller and are not credited to the file.
Built-ins are skipped; a module-level HTTP call is a CALLS_HTTP from the file entity.

tests.name: src/indexer/parser/__tests__/typescript-module-level-calls.test.ts: calls in a program-level expression statement (including nested describe/test callbacks), a non-function program-level or exported initializer, other program-level statements and export default, in both TypeScript (.ts) and JavaScript (.js) sources, are CALLS from the file entity; calls in function declarations, class methods, exported functions and classes and function-valued declarators keep their caller and are not credited to the file; built-ins are still skipped; a module-level HTTP call is a CALLS_HTTP from the file entity
